plain.li: I wonder how {OTHER_nameDef} is getting on out there.
No word from my {RELATION}, and no way to get any.
[partner] I keep thinking about {OTHER_nameDef} today.
[parent] I hope my {RELATION} is keeping well, wherever they are.
[child] Somewhere out there my {RELATION} is getting on without me.
[cold] I hope {OTHER_nameDef} has a warm place to sleep.
[rain|snow] I hope {OTHER_nameDef} is under a roof in this weather.

warm.li: Wherever {OTHER_nameDef} is, I hope someone is looking after them.

blunt.li: Can't stop thinking about my {RELATION} today.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is tougher than I am, so I'm sure they're fine.

gloomy.li: Out there, anything could have happened to {OTHER_nameDef} by now.

cold.li: My {RELATION} is out there somewhere, and there's nothing I can do about it.

plain.li: Today's the day {NAME} died.
[firstyear] A year ago today, we lost {NAME}.
[years] {YEARS} years today since {NAME} died.
I keep looking round for {NAME}, today of all days.
[kin] I miss {NAME} today more than most days.
[friend] {NAME} would have had something to say about all this.

warm.li: I think {NAME} would be glad of how we're doing here.

blunt.li: {NAME} died on this day, and I'm not in the mood for talking.

cheerful.li: {NAME} would hate to see me moping, but here I am.

gloomy.li: Today I can't stop seeing {NAME}'s face.
[years] Every year this day comes round, and every year it's the same.

cold.li: Today is the day {NAME} died, that's all.

plain.li: Some days I miss being {TITLE}.
I was {TITLE} once, before all this.
I keep thinking about the life I had before I came here.
[newcomer] It still doesn't feel like home here yet.
[past:farmer] I miss the fields I used to work.
[past:soldier] I keep thinking about the people I served with.
[past:trader] I keep thinking of the markets I used to know.
[past:noble] I had a name that opened doors once, and now look at me.
[past:scholar] I miss the arguments I used to have over books.
[past:healer] I wonder who looks after the people I used to care for.
[past:artisan] I miss my old workshop and the sound of it.
[past:outlaw] Part of me misses the old days, and I'm not proud of it.

warm.li: This is a good place, but I left people behind to come here.

cheerful.li: Funny, I never thought I'd miss being {TITLE}.

gloomy.li: Whoever I was before, I'm not that anymore.

cold.li: I was {TITLE}, and now I'm this, and that's how it is.

plain.li: {DAYS} days of {WORK} in a row, and I need a change.
Same work, same evenings, every single day.
I need something different to do, anything at all.
I could do {WORK} in my sleep by now.
Every day is the same day here lately.
[samejoy] One more evening spent the same way and I'll scream.

warm.li: I love it here, I just need a change of pace.

cheerful.li: It wouldn't hurt to shake things up around here.

gloomy.li: Is this all it's going to be, day after day?

plain.li: Everything aches today.
Slow going today, my body won't cooperate.
[cold] This cold gets right into my bones.
[rain] The damp is in my joints today.
[snow] Snow weather, and my joints know it.
[scar] My {PART} hasn't been right since that old wound.
[chronic] My {WHAT} is playing up again.
[age] I'm not as young as I was, and today I feel it.
[morning] Getting out of bed took longer than it should have.

warm.li: Don't mind me, I'm just a bit stiff today.

cheerful.li: Creaking like an old door, but still going.

gloomy.li: One day this body is going to give out on me.

cold.li: Pain is pain, and I'll work through it.

plain.li: I hardly slept a wink last night.
That dream is still with me.
I keep thinking about that nightmare.
[morning] I need a quiet morning after that night.

warm.li: I'll be fine, it was only a dream.

cheerful.li: Well, that's one dream I won't miss.

gloomy.li: I don't want to close my eyes tonight.

cold.li: A dream, nothing more, and I'll manage.

plain.li: [seat] {OTHER_nameDef} on the council, and I'm supposed to clap.
[name] They call {OTHER_nameDef} {HONOR} now, and I'm tired of hearing it.
[title] {OTHER_nameDef} with a title, of all people.
Why does {OTHER_nameDef} get all the honors around here?
I could do what {OTHER_nameDef} does, and better.
Some of us work just as hard without anyone noticing.

warm.li: I should be glad for {OTHER_nameDef}, and I'm trying.

cheerful.li: My turn will come, I suppose.

gloomy.li: Nobody's ever going to give me anything like that.

plain.li: Thought about {OTHER_nameDef} all day. My {RELATION} is out there somewhere, and I have no way of knowing how things are.
Couldn't settle today. I kept wondering whether {OTHER_nameDef} has enough to eat, and who looks out for them now.
[partner] Missed {OTHER_nameDef} today the way you miss a step in the dark. I keep reaching for something that isn't there.
[parent] My {RELATION} always said I'd end up somewhere strange. I wonder if they know how right they were.
[child] Somewhere out there my {RELATION} is making their own way. I hope they're doing better at it than I did.
Nobody here can tell me anything about {OTHER_nameDef}. I've half a mind to ask the next trader for news.

warm.li: Thought of {OTHER_nameDef} before bed. Wherever they are, I hope they're warm and among friends.

gloomy.li: It's been so long since I saw {OTHER_nameDef} that I'm starting to forget their voice. That frightens me more than I can say.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} chose their road and I chose mine. Still, I thought about them today.

plain.li: [firstyear] A year today since {NAME} died. I kept looking up every time the door opened.
[years] {YEARS} years today since we lost {NAME}. I still think of something to tell {NAME} before I remember.
Today was {NAME}'s day. I didn't say much to anyone, and I don't think I could have.
[kin] Some days I can still hear {NAME} laughing. Today was one of them, and it hurt.
[friend] Went about my work and thought about {NAME} the whole time. They'd have had a joke for every mistake I made.
I keep {NAME}'s memory close. Today it was too close.

warm.li: Thought of {NAME} all day. I hope they'd be proud of what we've made here.

gloomy.li: Another year without {NAME}. The world just keeps going as if nothing happened.

plain.li: I was {TITLE} once. Today I caught myself missing it, the good parts and the bad.
Some days this colony feels like someone else's life. Today was one of those days.
[newcomer] Still finding my feet here. Everything I knew how to do belongs to a life I've left behind.
[past:farmer] Kept thinking of the old fields today. I miss the smell of turned earth.
[past:soldier] Thought about the people I served with today. I don't miss the fighting, but I miss them.
[past:trader] Kept thinking of the markets I used to work. Haggling was half the fun.
[past:artisan] I miss my old workshop and the sound of it. I knew where every tool hung.
[past:healer] I wonder who looks after the people I used to care for. I hope someone does.
[past:scholar] I miss the long arguments of my old life. Nobody here wants to argue about anything that doesn't feed us.
[past:noble] Once I had a name that opened doors. Here it opens nothing, and today that stung.
[past:outlaw] The old life was no good, and I know it. Some days I still miss the freedom of it.

cold.li: I was {TITLE}. That's over. I'm writing it down so I stop thinking about it.

plain.li: {DAYS} days of {WORK} in a row. I need something to change, even a small thing.
Same work, same faces, same evening. I'm not unhappy, I'm just stuck.
[samejoy] If I spend one more evening the same way, I'll go mad. There has to be something else to do around here.
More {WORK} today. I could do it with my eyes shut by now, and that's the trouble.
Felt restless all day. I couldn't tell you why, except that every day lately has been the same.
Couldn't settle after work today. I need a change of scene, or a change of something.

cheerful.li: Life's good here, but it's the same good every day. Maybe tomorrow brings something new.

gloomy.li: Is this what the rest of my life looks like? {WORK}, supper, sleep, and again.

plain.li: Everything ached today. I got my work done, but it took longer than it should have.
[cold] The cold got into my bones today. I couldn't get warm.
[rain] Damp weather, and my joints let me know about it all day.
[scar] My {PART} hasn't been the same since that old wound. Today it reminded me.
[chronic] My {WHAT} played up all day. Some days I forget about it. Today wasn't one of them.
[age] I'm not as young as I was. Today my body made very sure I knew it.
Slow day. Stiff in the morning and sore by evening.

gloomy.li: Every year the aches get a little worse. I try not to think about where that ends.

plain.li: [seat] {OTHER_nameDef} carries that council seat as if they were born to it. I smiled today. I didn't mean it.
[name] Heard {OTHER_nameDef} called {HONOR} again today. I know what they did to earn it, and I know what I've done that nobody named me for.
[title] {OTHER_nameDef} with a title. I've worked just as hard, and nobody's handing me one.
I'm tired of watching {OTHER_nameDef} get the credit. It's petty, I know it's petty, and it still eats at me.
Tried to be glad for {OTHER_nameDef} today. Mostly I managed.
Why is it always {OTHER_nameDef}? I'd like to know what they have that I don't.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} holds what should be mine. I can wait.
